description: Source code for the SI message scheduler component in a 5G NR simulation or implementation, handling scheduling, window management, and grant allocation for system information messages.

classes.name: si_message_scheduler
classes.description: Class responsible for scheduling and transmitting system information messages in a 5G NR system.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Executes scheduling logic for a given slot, updating message windows and scheduling pending messages.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Clears all message windows and resets the scheduler state.

methods.name: handle_si_message_update_indication
methods.description: Updates the scheduler with new SI message configurations and resets counters.

methods.name: update_si_message_windows
methods.description: Manages SI message windows based on current slot and system frame number, detecting window start and end.

methods.name: schedule_pending_si_messages
methods.description: Schedules SI messages that are within their active window and meet monitoring criteria.

methods.name: allocate_si_message
methods.description: Allocates resources and grants for a specific SI message, including PDCCH and PDSCH setup.

methods.name: fill_si_grant
methods.description: Fills in the grant details for an SI message, including DCI and PDSCH configuration.
